svg.text: Session semantics — the retraction, and why keying is correctness
retract 7 then emit 11 at gap 40 · unkeyed collapses 5 sessions to 2
2 // Two of an event's five fields are CLOCKS, which ch01 established:
3 // et = event time, when it happened · pt = processing time, when we saw it
4 // v = the value being summed · key = whose activity this is
5 type Event { id, key, et, pt, v }
6 // primitive: EVENTS — the book's 9 events, in PROCESSING order (tools/stream_seed.js).
7 // EVENTS[7] = (id 7, key "b", et 50, pt 280, v 4) <- the straggler
8 // primitive: NONE — no value. Distinct from a value of 0.
9 // primitive: GAP — the session gap: silence longer than this ends a session. GAP = 120
10 // primitive: WIN — the fixed window width. WIN = 120
11 // primitive: LAG — the watermark's assumed worst-case skew. LAG = 60
12 // primitive: KEYS — the keys sessions are tracked per. KEYS = ["a", "b"]
13 // primitive: sum(ids) — total v over those event ids.
15 // primitive: append(xs, x) — xs with x added at the end. append([1], 2) = [1,2]
16 // primitive: sortByEt(es) — es in ascending event-time order.
18 // primitive: watermarkAfter(i) — highest event time through i, minus LAG.
24 // primitive: SMALL_GAP — a tighter session gap, for comparison. SMALL_GAP = 40
25 // primitive: sessionsUpto(key, gap, i) — that key's sessions from the events
26 // that have arrived by processing index i.
29 // primitive: collectedAt(s, gap) — the index at which s's state may be released.
32 // primitive: finalSession(key, gap, s) — the session s grows into once every
36 // function: emitPanes(key, gap) — every pane a consumer receives for that key,
37 // including any retraction forced by a member arriving after collection.
38 // emitPanes("b", SMALL_GAP) includes Pane(..., 7, "ON-TIME") then Pane(..., -7, "RETRACT") then Pane(..., 11, "LATE")
55 // function: storeTotal(panes, acceptsRetraction) — what the analytics store ends
56 // up holding. A store that drops retractions double-counts.
68 // function: sessionsIgnoringKey(gap) — the BUG: one session list for all keys.
74 if (last != NONE && e.et - last.end <= gap) { last.end = e.et · last.ids = append(last.ids, e.id) }
75 if (last == NONE || e.et - last.end > gap) { out = append(out, Session(e.et, e.et, [e.id])) }
Step 2/0 — so the pane must be UN-SAID, by its old bounds
Read the two `Pane` constructors: the retraction carries `s` — the OLD bounds — and the late pane carries `finalS`, different bounds. For a fixed window both panes would name the same window
and only the value would change. A session's bounds are its identity, so this is a delete and an insert.
